items.title: Do I receive the complete source code after purchase?
items.content: Yes. Once your order is confirmed, you are granted private Git repository access containing the complete, unencrypted Frontend, Backend, and Database schemas so you can customize and self-host freely.

items.title: Do you help with server deployment and domain configuration?
items.content: Every package includes step-by-step production setup documentation, plus the support window listed in your chosen package to assist with deployment questions and technical guidance.

items.title: What is the difference between Single and Multi-Project licenses?
items.content: A Single license authorizes deploying one production instance for yourself or one client. A Multi-Project license allows reusing the codebase across multiple launches and client deployments.

items.title: How and when is access delivered?
items.content: After payment confirmation, repository access is granted directly to the GitHub or GitLab username you provide at checkout, with real-time updates on your order tracking page.
